title: Hiring Approvals
description: Approvals for hiring a candidate who has passed the recruiting process: hiring manager, HR, finance and optionally the department head decide one after the other. Joule prepares the request, only people decide. Fictional sample data.
insights: Every request names one candidate in the stage Offer, the terms (level, band, start date, contract) and the evidence line from the recruiting process.
The chain runs hiring manager, HR, finance, optionally department head. Only the person whose turn it is can decide; nobody can hold two steps.
Return and Decline need a reason and end the request. A changed request is a new request. The log is append-only.
No salary amounts and no personal data. Fictional sample data in the page; with the desktop app and the shared database the same screen shows the real requests of the signed-in e-mail.
prompt: Bundled example: Hiring Approvals (live in the desktop app through a fixed bridge, otherwise sample data embedded by npm run sync:mockups).
